title: Worship
intro: Worship is at the center of our life together. Our Sunday service combines Scripture, prayer, music, preaching, and Holy Communion.

sections.heading: Sunday Worship — 10:00 AM
sections.text: Our principal weekly service is Holy Eucharist. The service follows the Book of Common Prayer and normally lasts about an hour.

sections.heading: Visitors and newcomers
sections.text: You do not need to know the Episcopal liturgy before you come. A bulletin provides what you need, and you are free to participate at your own pace.

sections.heading: Watch online
sections.text: When available, our Sunday service is streamed online. Use the Watch Online links on this site to reach our Facebook or YouTube channels.

sections.heading: Prayer and pastoral care
sections.text: If you would like prayer or need pastoral support, contact the church. We will help connect you with the appropriate person.
